description: This is a C source file implementing relocatable path handling functions, including prefix setting, path relocation, and shared library path retrieval, with platform-specific code for Windows and Linux.

methods.name: set_this_relocation_prefix
methods.description: Sets the original and current installation prefix strings for path relocation.

methods.name: set_relocation_prefix
methods.description: Sets the relocation prefixes and notifies dependent libraries.

methods.name: compute_curr_prefix
methods.description: Computes the current installation prefix based on original prefix, original directory, and current path.

methods.name: find_shared_library_fullname
methods.description: Platform-specific function to determine the full pathname of the loaded shared library.

methods.name: get_shared_library_fullname
methods.description: Returns the full pathname of the shared library if known.

methods.name: relocate
methods.description: Relocates a given pathname according to the set installation prefix.
